# public/images — generated assets, do not edit

Generated by `tools/fetch-images.mjs` from `src/content/images.manifest.json`; licence, credit, focus and LQIP data land in `src/content/images.json`.
Regenerate every country with `npm run images:fetch`, or a subset with `node tools/fetch-images.mjs --country=jp,id`.
Audit offline with `npm run images:check`: licence allowlist, alt 8–16 words, AVIF ≤ 600 KB per country, orphan files.
Originals are never committed — Commons masters stay in the gitignored `.cache/images/` staging dir.
